intro:
A slick, satisfying puzzler about untangling jammed car parks.
Slide vehicles in the right order and guide every car to the exit.
description:
Welcome to Parking Problem — a puzzle game about untangling jammed car parks. Slide vehicles in the right order, open up tight lanes, and guide every last car to the exit. It's quick to learn, deeply strategic, and perfect for that "one more puzzle" rhythm.

Tackle 150 handcrafted levels that gradually turn simple jams into clever brainteasers. New twists keep the grid fresh — tight corners, long vans, blocked lanes, one-way spaces, and gates to open — so planning two moves ahead really pays off. Stuck? Take a breath, rethink the order, and savor that sweet "aha!" when the lane finally clears.

Why you'll love it:
- 150 levels of clean, logic-driven parking puzzles
- Smooth slide controls and fast restarts for rapid iteration
- Smart difficulty curve: gentle warm-ups to devious jams
- Minimal, readable visuals that keep the board crystal-clear
- Play at your own pace — no timers, just pure strategy

Beat the gridlock, master the order, and enjoy the calm of a perfectly cleared lot in Parking Problem.
